column1: # Pilot A -- file-local names of ptcg/calculo/probabilidad.py.
# Nothing here crosses a module boundary: every name is a parameter or a local.
# Deliberately left out: `cartas` (also the package name, waves with phase 7)
# and the `_PescaRemate` fields `letal` / `premios` / `prob`, which are read
# from other modules and belong to the attribute phase. The parameters that
# callers pass BY KEYWORD moved to map 02: they are API, not locals.
# `activo -> active` is reported as a collision because `active` already
# exists in the file. It is a false positive, checked by hand: `active` only
# ever appears as an ATTRIBUTE (`.active`, 3 times) and never as a name, so
# the two never share a scope.
